items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: You see, Mills liked me because I used to always come downtown with Cab, and the songs he'd pick out, if they didn't have an arrangement for them, I'd make the arrangement

ctx.x: and... Because see, Cab, when we decided to stay with the band, I guess he got the idea to change to different musicians. So I guess I was next on the list. So I didn't think too much about it. I kind of hated to leave the band, because it was beginning to do good. So next time Cab and I went downtown to see Mills, I told Mills, I said, "I got my notice." He said, "What?! You got your notice? He must be crazy."
